header.description: Control for the DBM mask of arithmetic_neurons_fit.json: swap every one of the 14336 neurons of layer 18's MLP of Llama-3.1-8B from the counterfactual weekdays prompt at the last token and save the held-out interchange intervention accuracy against the counterfactual's output day; arithmetic_neurons_paper_neurons.json swaps only the 28 neurons of Feucht et al. 2026 (arXiv:2605.01148, Figure 8), and workflows/scripts/arithmetic_neurons/figures.py draws both beside the mask.
